## RE:volution Mod v2.3.0

### Added

- Added seven fixed rune collections with 26 persistent rune slots each and permanent sequential unlocks at 13 factual Improved-or-higher runes in the previous collection.
- Added the `MYTHIC` gameplay rank while keeping `ANCIENT` reserved for future progression.
- Added generic `CLICK`, `POISON`, `BURNING`, `BLEEDING`, `CURSE`, `WITHER`, and `DECAY` damage channels with server-authoritative confirmed-damage propagation.
- Added generic hybrid, delayed, temporary, effectiveness, targeted-power, enhancement-effectiveness, monster-gold, monster-resource, and Pet XP rune effect definitions.
- Added collection metadata synchronization and a functional Rune GUI foundation for collection selection, lock state, factual unlock progress, ranks, enhancements, and effect tooltips.
- Added permanent rune-collection unlock persistence, Mythic persistence, restart coverage, and deterministic legacy Collection 1 unlock migration.
- Added full Collection 1 through Collection 7 unlock-chain regression coverage and fixed-catalog validation for all seven 26-slot collections.

### Changed

- Rune progression, purchase, awakening, Rank Revert, combat, and rewards now resolve fixed collections through stable `RuneCollectionId` and `RuneSlotId` identities instead of treating GUI position or one legacy status as gameplay truth.
- Prestige reset now applies the generic rune rank policy: Ordinary and Improved reset to Ordinary, Advanced and Mythic are preserved, enhancements are preserved, and permanently unlocked collections never relock.
- New status damage runs through the neutral gameplay damage boundary so downstream systems observe the actual HP removed rather than requested damage.
- Monster gold and rune-resource bonuses now resolve generically for the active fixed collection while keeping the two reward channels separate and preserving Collection 1 behavior.
- Balance Core now loads and validates v2.3.0 collection/effect overlays, including duration, delay, target, trigger, multiplier, rank-transition, and fixed-slot constraints.

### Fixed

- Prevented technical Collections 2-7 from leaking their fixed damage channels into Collection 1 CLICK math.
- Prevented rune resource bonuses from being treated as coin bonuses or applying to crystals.
- Removed stale rank assumptions that treated Advanced as the maximum rank after Mythic progression was introduced.
- Replaced placeholder timed/effectiveness technical effects with first-class generic effect contracts and runtime behavior.

### Other

- Collection 1 identities, CLICK/POISON stacking behavior, unlimited enhancement progression, Rank Revert, Prestige channels, and managed-mob reward contracts remain regression-protected.
- `PET_XP_MULTIPLIER` is visible in definitions, Balance Core, and tooltips but remains a safe runtime no-op until the Pet System exists.
- New collection values, technical rune names, and content tuning remain ZBT Draft rather than Final balance.
- Ancient gameplay, Collection Meta Reset, Chest Upgrade, Pet gameplay/XP/slots, Artifacts, Forge, Mastery Quest, Generic Quest System, final art, and major visual polish remain outside this release.

### Download

Use the matching server and client gameplay artifacts published for this stable release.
